hypothesis: TRAIN-frequency content expansion plus context-specific question words improves short-message source-only coverage while retaining useful lexical meaning in surrounding native grammar.
new_holdout: 80 disjoint free-human VALID convai2 turns; 26/27/27 length bins; exclude all prior VALID dialogues, all TRAIN exact normalized messages, and previous evaluation texts. One case per dialogue.
primary: primary_union, with mixed and verified whole lexical scopes reported separately; content/function coverage separately; unchanged 100-entry control paired on the same inputs.
scoring: Review all unique selected scopes across arms in context; material/scope errors, minor hybrid grammar and uncertainties remain separate. No target full-translation prerequisite. Independent24 fixed before outputs. Not native bilingual certification.
whole_credit: Only an explicitly reviewed lexical candidate covering all source word tokens; no unreviewed full MT. Review semantic meaning of whole candidates exactly as mixed ones.
limitations: TRAIN-derived local guards are not a parser. Homographs, idioms and metaphorical senses can still fail.
